title: New client also creates the Main branch and shows its activation code
given: Logged in to the admin app (http://localhost:4400) on an empty cloud
when: Clients → '+ New client', fill Restaurant name 'Test Karahi', Owner phone '03001234567', Monthly fee 5000, Installation fee 15000, press 'Add client'
then: The client page opens with an activation-code card already visible (HZ-XXXX-XXXX) for a branch named 'Main branch'; the Branches table lists exactly 1 branch
how: page.getByRole('button',{name:'+ New client'}).click(); fill labels; click 'Add client'; expect(page.locator('.code')).toHaveText(/^HZ-[A-Z0-9]{4}-[A-Z0-9]{4}$/); expect(page.locator('table tbody tr')).toHaveCount(1) in the Branches card; API cross-check GET /api/owners → the new owner has branches.length === 1 and branches[0].name === 'Main branch'

title: Copy message for the client contains link, code and first-PIN line
given: The activation-code card is visible (A-01)
then: The clipboard text contains the installer URL (INSTALLER_URL or the default releases/latest link), the exact code shown, the words 'activation code', and a line about the first PIN
how: context.grantPermissions(['clipboard-read','clipboard-write']); click [data-testid=copy-install-message]; const t = await page.evaluate(() => navigator.clipboard.readText()); expect(t).toContain(await page.locator('.code').innerText()); expect(t).toMatch(/https:\/\/github\.com\/hassaanaiservices-lgtm\/-HazelPOS-releases\/releases\/latest|INSTALLER_URL value/); expect(t.toLowerCase()).toContain('pin')

title: GET /api/me returns installer_url
given: Admin server running, logged in
when: GET http://localhost:4400/api/me with the hz_admin cookie
then: 200, body has ok:true, user, cloud and installer_url (string starting with https://). With INSTALLER_URL set, it equals that value
how: curl -b cookie.txt http://localhost:4400/api/me → 200; jq '.installer_url' non-empty; restart with INSTALLER_URL=https://example.test/setup.exe → installer_url === 'https://example.test/setup.exe'

title: New client form shows 4 fields; the rest under More
given: Clients page
then: Visible inputs: Restaurant name, Owner phone, Monthly fee, Installation fee. Email, dashboard password, plan, paid until, notes and installation-paid are hidden until 'More' is opened; submitting with only name + phone still works
how: expect(modal.getByLabel(/Owner email/)).toBeHidden(); click modal.getByRole('button',{name:/More/}); expect(modal.getByLabel(/Owner email/)).toBeVisible(); create with name+phone only → toast 'Client added'

title: Branch page shows numbered steps and a checklist strip
given: A branch exists
then: Tabs in this order: '1 Details', '2 Menu', '3 Tables & delivery', '4 Staff & PINs', '5 Install', 'WhatsApp', 'Health'. No 'Overview' tab. [data-testid=branch-steps] is visible above the tabs and each item switches to its tab when clicked
how: const tabs = await page.getByRole('tab').allInnerTexts(); expect(tabs.map(s=>s.trim())).toEqual(['1 Details','2 Menu','3 Tables & delivery','4 Staff & PINs','5 Install','WhatsApp','Health']); click branch-steps item containing 'Menu items' → tab '2 Menu' has aria-selected=true

title: 'New activation code' is only in the Install step
given: An activated branch (code_used_at set)
when: Open the branch page on each tab
then: No 'New activation code' button in the page header or on any tab except '5 Install'; pressing it there shows the confirm 'When it is used, the PC that is activated now stops working' before making a code
how: for each tab except '5 Install': expect(page.getByRole('button',{name:/New activation code/})).toHaveCount(0); on '5 Install': click it → dialog text matches /stops working/; Cancel → no POST /api/branches/<id>/code request was sent (page.on('request'))

title: Tables and delivery areas share one tab and still save
given: Branch page, tab '3 Tables & delivery'
when: Add floor 'Ground', generate 4 tables, type one delivery area line 'Gulberg, 150, 800, 3000, 35', press both save buttons
then: GET /api/branches/<id>/setup → setup.tables has 4 rows on floor 'Ground'; setup.zones[0] = {name:'Gulberg', fee:150, min_order:800, free_above:3000, eta_min:35}
how: UI steps, then page.request.get('/api/branches/<id>/setup') and assert the JSON

title: Before activation: one Logins & PINs list with auto-filled first PINs
given: A branch not activated yet, tab '4 Staff & PINs'
then: Exactly one card about PINs. Rows Owner / Cashier / Kitchen with PIN boxes pre-filled with 6-character letters/numbers, all different; help text says each person chooses their own PIN at first login. The synced 'Show / Set PIN' table is not shown
how: expect(page.locator('.card h3', {hasText:/PIN/})).toHaveCount(1); const pins = await page.getByLabel('PIN').evaluateAll(els => els.map(e => e.value)); every pin matches /^[a-z0-9]{4,12}$/i and new Set(pins).size === pins.length; expect(page.getByRole('button',{name:'Show'})).toHaveCount(0)

title: After activation: only the synced PIN table; first-PIN editor behind a disclosure
given: The branch was activated by a POS (A-20) and the POS has reported its users
then: The table with Show / Set PIN is visible; the first-PIN editor is hidden until 'Send first PINs again (for a new PC)' is opened
how: expect(page.getByRole('button',{name:'Set PIN'}).first()).toBeVisible(); expect(page.getByLabel('PIN')).toHaveCount(0); click 'Send first PINs again' → PIN inputs appear

title: Role names read Owner / Cashier / Kitchen / Rider
given: Branch Staff step (before and after activation)
when: Read the role labels and the role select options
then: No visible text 'Admin (owner)' or 'Owner (admin)'; options are Owner, Cashier, Kitchen, Rider; the value sent for Owner is still 'admin'
how: expect(page.getByText(/Admin \(owner\)|Owner \(admin\)/)).toHaveCount(0); intercept POST /api/branches/<id>/setup and assert body.staff[0].role === 'admin'

title: Unpaid is a filter on Clients; old address still works
given: One client with paid_until 10 days ago, one paid
when: Open the sidebar, then open http://localhost:4400/#/unpaid
then: Sidebar has no 'Unpaid' item. #/unpaid shows the Clients page with the 'Unpaid' chip selected and only the unpaid client; its row has 'Paid: +1 month', '+7 days' and 'Pause'
how: expect(page.locator('nav[aria-label=Main] a', {hasText:'Unpaid'})).toHaveCount(0); goto '#/unpaid'; expect(page.getByRole('tab',{name:/Unpaid/})).toHaveAttribute('aria-selected','true'); rows count 1; buttons visible

title: Membership card: one main button; rare actions under More
given: A client page
then: Visible: one sentence with paid-until and the stop dates, 'Paid: +1 month', 'Pause' (or 'Resume'). '+3 months', 'Set date', the days editor and 'End membership' appear only after opening 'More'
how: card = page.locator('.card',{hasText:'Membership'}); expect(card.getByRole('button',{name:'+3 months'})).toBeHidden(); click card 'More' → visible

title: Paid: +1 month still extends from the later of today and paid-until
given: Client A paid_until = today+10, client B paid_until = today-5
then: A becomes (today+10)+1 month; B becomes today+1 month. Same as POST /api/vendor/owners/:id/extend {months:1}
how: POST http://localhost:4400/api/owners/<A>/extend {months:1} (cookie + X-Hazel-Admin:1) → 200, paid_until === addMonths(A.paid_until,1); same for B → addMonths(today,1)

title: One word per idea: Pause / Paused / End membership
given: Admin app and a suspended client
when: Read the client pill, the buttons and the confirm dialog
then: Pill text 'Paused'; buttons 'Pause' / 'Resume'; no visible 'Stop now', 'Stopped' or 'Suspend' anywhere in the admin app. API still sends {suspended:true}
how: visit #/clients, #/client/<id>: expect(page.getByText(/Stop now|Stopped|Suspend/)).toHaveCount(0); intercept POST /api/owners/<id> and assert body.suspended === true

title: Clients page shows 3 numbers
given: Clients page with data
then: Exactly 3: Clients, Need attention, Unpaid
how: expect(page.locator('.kpi')).toHaveCount(3); texts contain 'Clients','Need attention','Unpaid'

title: Staff team role still cannot manage the team (regression SA2)
given: Cloud with VENDOR_API_KEY
when: GET and POST /api/vendor/team and /api/vendor/TEAM with X-Vendor-Role: staff
then: 403 'Only an owner can manage the team' for /api/vendor/team; /api/vendor/TEAM is 404 (case-sensitive routing), never 200
how: curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $VK' -H 'X-Vendor-Role: staff' http://localhost:4200/api/vendor/team → 403; POST same with body {email,password,role:'owner'} → 403; /api/vendor/TEAM → status !== 200

title: PIN reveal stays owner-only and logged (regression P1)
given: An activated branch whose POS pushed its PINs
when: POST /api/vendor/branches/<id>/pins/<uid>/reveal with X-Vendor-Role: staff, then with owner
then: staff → 403 'Only an owner can see PINs'; owner → 200 {pin}; GET /api/vendor/audit shows the reveal by the owner and no PIN value in any detail
how: curl both; then GET /api/vendor/audit?limit=20 and assert no detail contains the revealed pin

given: POS started with HAZEL_LICENCE=1 and no HAZEL_CLOUD_URL

how: fill code input with lower-case/spaced code; click 'Activate'; wait for response of /api/licence/activate; assert JSON; expect(page.getByTestId('first-login-hint')).toContainText(/gave you/i)

then: [data-testid=first-login-hint] is not shown any more

title: Regression: activation code rules (one use, wrong, expired, unpaid)
given: Cloud in vendor mode
when: POST http://localhost:4200/api/activate with (a) a wrong code, (b) a valid code, (c) the same code again, (d) a code whose code_created_at is 15 days old (edit cloud.db in the temp DATA_DIR), (e) a valid code of a suspended client
then: (a) 400, (b) 200 {key:'hz_…', branch}, (c) 400, (d) 410 'expired', (e) 402. 10 wrong codes from one address → 429
how: curl -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"code":"HZ-XXXX-XXXX"}' http://localhost:4200/api/activate for each case; loop 10 wrong → last status 429

then: activate → 502 'Could not activate: This HazelPOS can only be activated on HazelPOS Cloud'; cloud/connect → 400 'This HazelPOS connects to HazelPOS Cloud only'
how: curl both; assert status and error text

then: 403 {error:'Activate HazelPOS first'}; GET /api/licence → state 'activate'

given: An activated POS with no setup staff (A-21)
when: (1) login {pin:'1111'} (cashier starting PIN); (2) login {pin:'1234'}; (3) with that token GET /api/orders; (4) POST /api/me/pin {pin:'2222'}; (5) POST /api/me/pin {pin:'ali2026'}; (6) GET /api/orders
then: (1) 403 'This is a starting PIN…'; (2) 200 with user.must_change_pin true; (3) 403 code 'change_pin'; (4) 400 (weak PIN); (5) 200; (6) 200
how: curl sequence with Authorization: Bearer <token>; assert statuses and codes

title: Regression: setup staff must choose their own PIN; PIN format

then: Login 200 with must_change_pin true; 'ab' and 'abc!def' sent straight to the API → 400 'PIN must be 4 to 12 letters or numbers'; 5 wrong logins from one device → 429
how: curl /api/login with first PIN; POST /api/me/pin bad values; loop 5 wrong PINs → 6th is 429
